days.label: Day 1
days.title: The layer starts
days.note: The first run only records what exists, so nothing old is announced. TC-1007 was created yesterday, so its assignee hears about it.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Two tasks close
days.note: John and Alex close their tasks. Each gets a completion check, the issuer hears at once, and the next open task is named. A new task appears and one spec changes.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Answers and questions
days.note: Answer a check, ask a question in a task thread, or open a support ticket, then advance the day. John has not answered, so he gets a reminder.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Reviews and a call
days.note: A doubtful grade waits for the issuer. A check that stays unanswered for two days becomes a phone call; here nobody picks up.

days.label: Day 5
days.title: The loop closes
days.note: The issuer hears that the call went unanswered. Running a day twice sends nothing twice.
